Behind the image
17 / Jade Hanbok
REFERENCE 5089.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 016
Art direction: Korean-inspired period portrait, moody teal backdrop, painterly chiaroscuro, analog
print feeling.
Cinematic vertical portrait of an original adult East Asian woman with dark hair parted in the
center and gathered into two low side buns, held by a long decorative hairpin with an ornate metal
tip on one side. Soft blush on the cheeks, rosy-coral lips, calm direct gaze with a slight head tilt.
She wears a black Korean-inspired hanbok-style jacket with a crossed white collar. Dark teal-green
textured painterly backdrop, soft directional window light creating a gentle diagonal shadow
across the face, muted jade and black palette, vintage analog photo print texture with fine grain
and slightly faded colors, quiet and elegant mood, no text.
18 / Cemetery Gothic
REFERENCE 5213.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 017
Art direction: Gothic romance, damp green and gray stone tones, cinematic film grain, solemn
mood.
Cinematic vertical full-length portrait of an original adult woman standing with her arms crossed
in an old overgrown cemetery in autumn, surrounded by weathered stone headstones and
monuments covered in moss. Her light brown hair is pulled back into a single long braid. She
wears a black Victorian-inspired velvet jacket with a high ruffled collar, a fitted waist belt, and a
long black lace-embroidered skirt. Calm, serious gaze toward the camera. Overcast soft daylight,
shallow depth of field, blurred green foliage and fallen leaves, desaturated green, gray and black
palette, 35mm film look with fine grain, gothic romantic period atmosphere, no text.
